ModMetaData.name: Simple Stockpile Presets
ModMetaData.author: Lanilor, Mlie
ModMetaData.description:
Local fix of Simple Stockpile Presets.
Original by Lanilor. Continued by Mlie. Workshop: https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2189006791 Source: https://github.com/emipa606/SimpleStockpilePresets License: MIT. French translation by Imprécation.
Select a stockpile or shelf, open the Storage tab, and use Select preset. The same button is also on the selection bar.
Disable the Workshop copy (Mlie.SimpleStockpilePresets) while this one is active.
